name: Sliced Waves
description: WebGL2 background of glowing vertical bars forming flowing, perspective-tilted ribbon waves in a three-color gradient, with film grain, intro sweep and pointer focus effect.
contents: Full-size container with a single WebGL2 canvas filling it
behavior: Ribbons of vertical bars undulate over time with animated colors blending between three palette colors
Intro sweep grows the bars from left to right on mount
Pointer over the page focuses the nearest bar, sharpening it and lifting brightness locally
Rendering pauses when offscreen or tab hidden, and animation is static with reduced motion
Resizes with its container, render resolution capped at 2560px and pixel ratio at 2
editableByProps: Three gradient colors, number of ribbons (1 to 6), bar spacing and width
Ribbon height, spread, wave amplitude, frequency and speed
Perspective, curve, blur, glow, brightness, vertical position, rotation
Horizontal slicing of bars, grain, edge fade, opacity
Pointer interaction, intro, pause, light mode for light backgrounds, pixel ratio

needsCodeEdit.where: wave calculation inside the build function

needsCodeEdit.change: Change pointer focus spring or lift response
needsCodeEdit.where: focusVelocity and lift updates in the frame function

fixed: Requires WebGL2; renders nothing if unavailable
Fills its parent, so the parent needs a defined height
Listens to pointer movement on the whole window, not only the container
Honors prefers-reduced-motion by disabling motion, intro and pointer effects
Maximum of 6 ribbons; the palette has exactly three colors
Output is transparent with additive glow; light mode is a separate rendering path chosen by lightMode
Scales to any screen size via container resize, but heavy GPU load on small mobile devices is possible at high ribbon counts
